title: Sales Commission Agreement

issues.quote: Representative is entitled to a commission on each Qualified Sale that Representative closes while this Agreement is in effect.
issues.why: "Qualified Sale" drives every commission but is never defined (anchored at its 1st use).
issues.fix: Add a definition: "Qualified Sale" means a sale of a solar installation to a customer in Representative's territory for which the customer has signed Company's purchase contract.

issues.quote: The commission rate shall be 6% of the Net Revenue from each Qualified Sale.
issues.why: No duty imposed; language of policy.
issues.fix: The commission rate is 6% of the Net Revenue from each Qualified Sale.

issues.quote: Company shall pay Representative a bonus of $2,000 for each sale of a battery-storage system or a Service Contract exceeding $50,000.
issues.why: "exceeding $50,000" can modify only the Service Contract or both the battery-storage system and the Service Contract.
issues.fix: Restructure, for example: for each sale of a battery-storage system, and for each Service Contract with a price over $50,000.

issues.quote: Company shall pay each commission on the fifteenth day of the month after the month in which the customer pays Company in full.
issues.fix: on the 15th day of the month

issues.quote: For Qualified Sales that Representative closes from January 1 to March 31 of each year, the commission rate is 8% instead of 6%.
issues.why: "from ... to" leaves unclear whether the end dates are included.
issues.fix: For Qualified Sales that Representative closes during the period starting on January 1 and ending on March 31 of each year, the commission rate is 8% instead of 6%.

issues.quote: Representative should enter each Qualified Sale in Company's customer-relationship-management system no later than 2 days after closing that sale.
issues.fix: Representative shall enter each Qualified Sale ...

issues.quote: Company may, in its sole discretion, change Representative's territory by notice to Representative.
issues.fix: Company may change Representative's territory by notice to Representative.

issues.quote: Representative shall offer the products of Company and/or its affiliates only to customers in Representative's territory.
issues.fix: the products of Company, of Company's affiliates, or of both

issues.quote: If a customer cancels a Qualified Sale and receives a refund no later than 90 days after installation, Representative agrees to repay the related commission to Company.
issues.fix: Representative shall repay the related commission to Company.

issues.quote: Company may deduct any repayment from one or more later commission payments to Representative.
This Agreement is the parties' entire agreement regarding commissions. The parties may amend this Agreement only in a writing that both parties sign.

issues.anchor: Representative is entitled to a commission
issues.quote: Representative is entitled to a commission on each Qualified Sale that Representative closes while this Agreement is in effect.
issues.why: MSCD 3.169: don't use is entitled to to impose an obligation on someone other than the subject; it hides who must pay or deliver.
issues.fix: Company shall pay Representative a commission ...
issues.source: MSCD 3.169 (key corrected by reviewer: was listed as a trap)

traps.anchor: Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code
traps.quote: Company intends each commission payment to qualify as a short-term deferral under Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code.
Company is not required to pay any commission on a sale that Representative closes after the termination date.
After termination, Company shall pay Representative commissions on Qualified Sales that Representative closed before the termination date, on the schedule in the section titled "Commissions."
traps.why_correct: Correct house-style cross-reference by heading (house rule 4).

notes: Whose draft is unknown. Party names have no article; A./1. enumeration is correct. "Qualified Sale" is a document-level defined-term issue anchored at its 1st use (B.1); C.1, C.2, E.1, and F.2 use it again. The only spacing error is in G.2.
